name: PT Royal Prima Tbk
summary: PT Royal Prima Tbk engages in providing hospital services and drugs in Indonesia. The company operates its hospitals under the Royal Prima Medan, Royal Prima Jambi, and RSU Royal Prima Marelan names. The company also provides health services, such as inpatient and outpatient medical services, including specialist and sub-specialist care. In addition, the company offers orthopaedic, eye, neurology, internal medicine, obstetrics and gynaecology, heart, lung, Ent-kl, urology.
